newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American to buy and lease 3 hotels.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American to buy and lease 3 hotels.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said Friday it reached contracts to acquire three historical hotels in St. Louis, Birmingham, Ala., and Nashville for about $29.2 million, or $65,000 per room.
It said Grand Heritage Hotels International will become Patriot American's sixth hotel lessee and the three properties are to be the initial hotels leased to Grand Heritage.
Patriot said it intends to acquire additional historical hotels, typically in the central downtown areas of major cities. Grand Heritage will lease and manage the properties.
Grand Heritage, based in Annapolis, Md., owns and operates historic hotels in the U.S. and Europe.

The three properties Patriot has under contract to acquire are the 184-room Mayfair Hotel & Suites, in downtown St. Louis; the 147-room Tutwiler Hotel, in downtown Birmingham; and the 124-room Union Station Hotel, in downtown Nashville.
